title: Stack Nudge dedup: check the marker against the comment author as `gh pr view` reports it (`github-actions`), not `github-actions[bot]`
answers: The stacked PR nudge comment keeps getting reposted every time I edit the PR description
Why doesn't my `gh pr view --json comments` jq filter match the github-actions comment author?
How does the PR automation avoid posting duplicate comments on edits?
body:
Path: The duplicate-suppression check in stack-nudge.yml (job `nudge`, step `Nudge`). Before posting, it lists the PR's comments with `gh pr view --json comments --jq` and looks for the hidden marker `<!-- mlflow-stack-nudge -->` authored by the Actions bot, then exits early if found; otherwise it posts with `gh pr comment`.
Rule: `gh pr view --json comments` exposes the author as `.author.login` = `github-actions`, whereas the REST comments API reports `.user.login` = `github-actions[bot]`. Match the `gh` form in jq for this step. A comparison against `github-actions[bot]` never matches, so the marker is never seen and every qualifying `edited` event posts another nudge. Keep the marker string identical in the check and in the posted body.
Symptom: The stacked-PR nudge comment was reposted on every PR description edit instead of appearing once.
Constraints: Applies to `gh` jq filters. If the check is ever moved to `gh api` / REST, the login must become `github-actions[bot]` (`.user.login`) instead. Does not change the author gating in the job `if:`.
applies: Any duplicate-comment or bot-author check written with gh CLI jq output in this repo's Actions workflows.
says: The bot reposts the stacked pull request comment every time the description is edited.
Editing a pull request description should not trigger repeated automated stack reminder comments.
Stacked pull request notifications keep duplicating after each change to the pull request summary.
Ensure the stacked pull request bot comments only once per pull request.
search: In .github/workflows/stack-nudge.yml, the duplicate-suppression step must inspect gh pr view --json comments --jq output for author login github-actions instead of github-actions[bot]. Because gh pr view exposes the author as .author.login = github-actions while the REST API reports .user.login = github-actions[bot], comparing against github-actions[bot] never matches and causes duplicate nudge comments on every pull request description edit. The check requires the hidden marker <!-- mlflow-stack-nudge --> to match identically between the check and posted body, applies to gh CLI jq filters in Actions workflows, and does not alter workflow job-level author gating.
